themes.name: Retire VB6 COM and ActiveX
themes.action: Rebuild the controls as Angular Material components; ADO and MSXML calls move to the Spring Boot API
themes.rationale: COM and ActiveX do not run on GCP.

themes.name: Replace .NET data access
themes.action: Spring Data JPA or JdbcTemplate on PostgreSQL
themes.rationale: Dapper, SqlClient and Entity Framework go with the .NET code.

themes.name: Logging and JSON
themes.action: SLF4J with Logback and Jackson, as Spring Boot 4 provides
themes.rationale: log4net 2.0.8 and Newtonsoft.Json 9.0.1 are old; their Java counterparts come with the platform.
